product_metadata.title: Ezprogear 24 oz Stainless Steel Black Coffee Mug with Handle Insulated Water Tumbler with Lid (Black)
features: Simple design, Elegant look 24 oz Ezprogear’s Stainless Steel tumbler with various colors to pick. This powder coated tumbler is a perfect for your carry-on drink whether its indoor or outdoor. Comfortable attached handle with full loop design and easy to grip while you enjoy your drink. This 24 oz mug does not fit vehicle’s cup holder.

Made from high quality 304 18/8 food grade stainless steel, strong and durable make the tumbler is unbreakable for long time use. Rust resistant and easy-reach to clean by hand. Come with removable sliding Lid to provide maximum spill resistance which means no more splashes worry.

This 24 oz tumbler is design with vacuum insulated technology for known as heat preservation to keep your hot and cold beverage for many hours longer than regular cup. The double Wall is design for Sweat-Free and comfortable to hold on hand.

We offer the exclusive bundle, with this package you’ll get 1x 24 oz tumbler, 1x sliding lid, 2x 8mm (0.31 inch) wide straw and 1x brush for cleaning your straw. You can choose many vibrant colors we carry that will surely fit every single personality.
This 24 oz mug does not fit car holder. The bottom diameter is 3.46 Inch.
